structure.description: Dataset: LABOUR_ACCT_Q. Australian Labour Account integrates labour market data from different sources into coherent and consistent statistics. It consists of four central quadrants of Jobs, Persons, Hours and Payments. Data is available quarterly for the industry divisions by ANZSIC. Unit of measure: Persons, jobs, hours and dollars. Geographic coverage: Australia/State. Catalogue number: 6150.0.55.003

descriptions.en: Dataset: LABOUR_ACCT_Q. Australian Labour Account integrates labour market data from different sources into coherent and consistent statistics.
